name: doorway
description: Doorway is a complete RLOGIN and Telnet BBS made for the old multiuser DOS door games. It comes preloaded with the last published version of L.O.R.D., L.O.R.D. 2, Exitilus (the reason I built this container), Planets, Death Masters, DoorMud, Drakeville and MELEE. This container can be use standalone but it's intended to be an RLOGIN target for a main BBS. Most door games are configured for up to 10 simultaneous nodes.
